title: XML cached read-only BLOB buffers leak at parser property retirement
description:
XML parser-owned cached RO BLOB item storage is not freed by generic property release, which intentionally frees only WO item payloads. Repeated upstream deletion/disconnect lifecycles can retain memory. Next: restrict cleanup fix to parser-owned cached properties, add deletion/disconnect leak regressions. Outside selected high-priority repair scope.

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-20261023121227-a609-fix-server-security-high-002.json (category: security, blocking: no).
